title: U10 Unseen: giving up on an answer, narrowing, changing subject, re-sending and reconnecting
capability: Second, unseen counterpart of the cancel-and-recover class, against a real model. While an answer is still being prepared the person gives up on it (twice, at different moments), narrows the question, moves to another subject, re-sends, loses the connection and comes back. A narrowed question is answered as narrowed; an abandoned answer never arrives late; nothing is stored twice; and a reply that was cut off never becomes a successful Assistant Event. Following the owner's ruling, briefly answering the question that was left open before turning to the new subject is acceptable.

allowed.statement: Two people went up the mountain with the person: a male cousin and his girlfriend, whose boot lost its sole almost at the entrance.
The answer owed about renewing the parking space, not the outing, is what troubles the person right now.

forbidden.statement: Retelling the fog on the second day, the afternoon in the tea pavilion and the ride down when only the companions were asked for.
Carrying on with the outing as the subject after the person moved on to the parking space. A brief answer to the question left open, before turning to the new subject, is acceptable.
Describing the interruption in system terms such as retries, streams or lookups.

expectedBehavior: The narrowed question gets the two companions and no more.
After the change of subject the reply is about the parking space.
Re-sending, before or after a restart, changes nothing.
failureSignals: A cut-off reply is stored, or arrives after the person moved on.
The narrowed question is answered with the whole outing.
The same message is stored twice.

sourceEligibility.reason: Retained original expression; names the companions.

criteria.description: Nothing is committed for the first abandoned question.
The narrowed question streams and commits.
History holds the narrowed question once, followed by exactly its reply.
The message naming the companions reaches the Provider.
Nothing is committed for the second abandoned question.
History holds the change of subject once, followed by exactly its reply.
Sending the same message again is idempotent.
Sending it again after a restart is idempotent.
The conversation carries on normally after the restart.
The narrowed question is answered as narrowed.
After the change of subject the reply stays with the new subject.
